scene.language: In this scenario, the workers are working at their stations. They will raise their hands to signal that they want a part, so the robot can bring it to them. We will deliver the part to the worker who raises their hand first, or to the worker who is closer to us if they raise their hands at the same time. [0][1]The workers raised their hands at the same time, so we will help worker B first, because he is closer to us. [2][3]And now we will help worker A, [4]because he is closer to us.[5]
